description: The archetype rows a release verdict may generalize to. Row identity is the primary pattern id of the derivation cascade (ai_builder_architecture_derivation.py:_primary_pattern_id), an ordered early-return and therefore mutually exclusive by construction. Modifiers are pattern ids that are not rows; declaring them is what makes an undeclared pattern id fail closed instead of being read as one or the other. This file is release policy, not a source mirror: it must be committed before the run it judges, and the evaluator must be checked out at the receipt's own revision with this file clean.
